decision.question: Which first audience should we test for invoice automation?
decision.answer: Start with Romanian accounting firms serving micro-businesses, then validate the workflow with one partner-led pilot.

context.product: An app that imports invoices from different sources and submits them to a person's Romanian SPV.
context.market: Romania, invoice administration for micro-businesses and their accounting partners.
knowns: The product removes repeated invoice intake and submission steps.
assumptions: Accounting firms feel the workflow pain across several clients.
unknowns: Who owns the purchase decision inside the firm?
Which integration or compliance concern could stop a pilot?

tickets.title: Validate the repeated invoice workflow with accounting firms
tickets.evidence_needed: Evidence that the workflow repeats, hurts, and has an identifiable buyer.
acceptance_criteria: Name one segment and one likely buyer role.
Cite two independent sources or mark the result insufficient.

tickets.title: Choose a positioning angle for the first audience
tickets.evidence_needed: Proof that the chosen audience values fewer manual invoice steps.
acceptance_criteria: Write one positioning choice and one excluded alternative.
Label unsupported differentiation as a hypothesis.

tickets.title: Check one competitor promise against customer experience
tickets.evidence_needed: One first-party promise and two independent experiences about the same promise.
acceptance_criteria: Capture the exact promise and source.
Use at least two independent customer sources for a possible gap.
Write a careful sales question, not an accusation.

artifacts.title: First audience hypothesis
artifacts.summary: Accounting firms serving micro-businesses are a promising first segment because one workflow may repeat across many clients.

claims.claim: Public job language in the fixture describes recurring invoice handling as part of an accounting role.
A partner-led pilot could test repeated value faster than selling one small business at a time.
The firm owner or operations lead will be the first buyer.

evidence.excerpt: The role handles recurring invoice collection, checks, and client follow-up.
supports: recurring invoice work appears in the target workflow

evidence.excerpt: We still reconcile invoices manually when files arrive through different channels.
supports: multiple invoice sources create manual reconciliation friction

next_actions: Interview three accounting firms and ask them to walk through the last invoice exception.
Use the interview results to unblock T-002.
human_decisions: Approve the accounting-firm segment as the first discovery focus.
Approve access to any internal product or pilot data before making a public claim.
